surface: product illustration on product cards and inventory lists
source: generated in-house for this store; no third-party photograph, no brand logo, no face
rules: illustrations are symbolic: they make no claim about the product, its notes, its family or its authenticity
the card shows the disclosure «تصویر نمادین» for every studio illustration
allocation is cyclic over catalogue order so a page never looks like one repeated image
owner-uploaded and brand photographs always win and are never overwritten by this allocation
legacy: generic-neutral-1..7 remain recognised as symbolic so older rows and cached pages keep their disclosure
